text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 - elevated error rate for /v1/generate affecting customer QuantumPay (account: QPAY-882). Auto-paging to oncall.
maya (oncall): saw the page, joining bridge now. can someone pull last 15m error spikes?
ashley (sre): looking, 5xx rate went from 0.2% -> 12% starting ~00:06 UTC. traces show increased latency at inference-gateway-03.
ravi (eng): on the bridge. could be a model variant fallback loop under load, grabbing logs.
leon (acct-ops): heads-up — QuantumPay is on our enterprise SLA 99.95, high-touch. Primary contacts: Alice Chen (alice.chen@quantumpay.com), Ops Pager (ops+qpay@quantumpay.com). BCP requires tailored customer brief within 20m.
maya (oncall): agreed. priority: stabilize for QPay traffic, prepare customer-facing note. who can draft status copy?
amaya (typo correction): ignore — maya continuing.
sam (infra): I see intermittent gRPC timeouts between gateway and runner pool. restarting runner-nodes in eu-west-2c now (rolling) — will report.
ashley (sre): initiating traffic shadowing to fallback pool (safe-mode) for QPAY-882 to reduce pressure. routing rule applied: quantumpay -> fallback-quantumpay-1.
ravi (eng): adding a temporary rate-limit at ingress for QPay (50rps) to reduce retries. will monitor latency/5xx.
maya (oncall): drafting customer note below, please review.
maya (oncall): ```
Hi Alice / QuantumPay team,

We’re investigating elevated errors affecting your inference requests to our hosted API. Impact: increased 5xx and delays for calls to /v1/generate since ~00:06 UTC.

What we’re doing: diverting traffic to a verified fallback pool, applying ingress rate-limits to reduce retries, and performing rolling restarts of runner nodes.

Next update: 15 minutes or sooner.

Sincerely,
Redwood Inference Ops
```
leon (acct-ops): good tone, please add: "No data was exfiltrated; requests remain encrypted in transit and at rest." also add AM contact (leon@redwood.ai) for priority channel.
maya (oncall): updated draft. sending to Alice after legal sign-off? do we need legal?
leon (acct-ops): not for this wording, I'm sending now from my account and cc'ing leon@redwood.ai.
statuspage-bot: Draft status created: "Partial service degradation for Enterprise customer traffic (QuantumPay). Investigating." URL: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/5143210987-draft
ravi (eng): rollback note: if runner restarts don't restore healthy p95 within 10m, we escalate to model-team and flip to cold-fallback (quantumpay-static-1).
sam (infra): nodes restarted, one failed to rejoin (runner-07). isolating runner-07 and draining. p50 latency improving already.
ashley (sre): 5xx down from 12% -> 3.1% after routing change. still above baseline; continue monitoring.
maya (oncall): preparing internal comms template for account team — copy below.
maya (oncall): ```
Internal — QuantumPay incident brief (for account ops/sales):
- Impact: Intermittent 5xx and increased latency for QuantumPay billing API calls since 00:06 UTC.
- Scope: ~7% of QPay requests affected at peak, primarily eu-west-2.
- Actions taken: diverted QPay traffic to fallback pool, ingress rate-limit applied, rolling restarts of runner nodes, isolating failing runner-07.
- Current status: error rate down to 3.1%, p95 latency trending down.
- Next steps: monitor 30m, prepare customer follow-up in 15m, coordinate RCA with model infra team post-stable.
- Contacts: Maya (oncall), Ashley (SRE lead), Ravi (eng), Leon (Account ops).
```
leon (acct-ops): looks good. add expected ETA for customer: "Targeting full restoration within 45 minutes, will update earlier if resolved."
maya (oncall): added ETA. I'll send internal brief to account@redwood.ai and post statuspage update in 10m.
ravi (eng): note: implement a temporary request-de-duplication header patch to reduce client retries for QPay — pushing change now (hotfix).
sam (infra): hotfix deployed to gateway-02/03. observing reduction in retry traffic.
ashley (sre): monitoring: 5xx now 0.9% over 5m window. p95 back near baseline.
maya (oncall): recommendation: keep QPay on fallback-quantumpay-1 for 30m, then gradual shift if stable.
leon (acct-ops): I sent the tailored email to Alice & Ops Pager with the approved wording, cc'ed product and legal. Alice responded: "Thanks. We see improvements on our side. Keep us posted."
maya (oncall): great. closing handoff to morning oncall at 06:00 UTC per schedule — @ashley please track post-mortem and customer RCA.
ashley (sre): acknowledged, will own RCA and timeline. tagging model infra for follow-up.
incident-bot: Incident status changed to "Mitigated". Root cause investigation ticket created: INC-514321 (assigned to ashley).
maya (oncall): final note: please add QuantumPay to follow-up runbook for model-variant fallback tuning (action owner: ravi).
ravi (eng): noted. will schedule a tuning window and share recommendations in #eng-runtime within 48h.
statuspage-bot: Published update: "Mitigated — routing change and infra restarts reduced errors for QuantumPay; monitoring. Full RCA pending."
maya (oncall): thanks team. handing off to ashley for RCA and postmortem.
